description:
[Merchant] Delete a placement. **Its printed codes and its payware link stop resolving**, and its ID is never reused. To stop airing and attribution but keep printed codes working, replace it with active false instead.

**Endpoint:** DELETE /products/{productId}/placements/{placementId} (PRM plan)

placementId.description: The placement's ID: pl + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pl7e4rCToG

productId.description: The product's ID: pr + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pr7e4rCToG

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_products_delete_placement
